name: Logitech C920s Pro HD Webcam
description: A Full HD 1080p webcam with autofocus, automatic light correction, dual stereo microphones and a privacy shutter. A practical option for online classes and video meetings.

name: Dell Pro 3 Webcam 2K (WB3023)
description: A 2K QHD webcam supporting up to 2560 × 1440 resolution at 60 fps, with a 78° field of view, autofocus and built-in microphone. Check device and software compatibility before buying.

name: Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard
description: A low-profile wireless keyboard with smart backlighting, programmable keys and multi-device switching. Designed for comfortable, precise typing at a desk.

name: Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1)
description: A compact USB-C hub that adds multiple connections, including HDMI, USB and card access. The manufacturer lists 4K at 60Hz HDMI output and up to 85W charging; verify your laptop's USB-C capabilities.

name: Samsung T7 Shield Portable SSD (1TB)
description: A rugged 1TB portable SSD with USB 3.2 Gen 2, IP65-rated protection and advertised sequential read/write speeds of up to 1,050/1,000 MB/s. Actual speeds depend on the connected device and setup.
